election_108b5: NO (default attribute order) - reasoning: (1) the NOL pool absorbs the entire reduction with 640,000.00 left over, so no excluded income is 'wasted' against a depleted attribute; (2) declining the election preserves the full 3,200,000.00 depreciable tax basis (ongoing depreciation deductions) while the surviving 640,000.00 NOL still offsets future income; (3) the library states reductions are made AFTER the tax for the year of discharge is determined (irc_108.md (b)(1)) - no discharge-year tax effect either way. Full-election alternative for comparison: apply 3,200,000.00 to depreciable basis first (basis -> 0) and the remaining 2,260,000.00 to NOL -> NOL after = 3,840,000.00; that trades 3,200,000.00 of depreciation basis for 3,200,000.00 of extra NOL and is not recommended on these facts. A YES election could make sense only if the NOL is wasting or unusable - e.g., a possible IRC 382 ownership-change limitation from the 40% equity issuance to the DIP lender; IRC 382 is NOT in library/INDEX.md, so that analysis is [unverified] and must be run by tax counsel with the tax rate and NOL vintage data (still not in the file).
